qs.en: These jewels belonged to Marie's grandmother.

qs.en: They belonged to a religious community in their youth.

qs.en: When I was a child, I belonged to a scout troop.

qs.en: This painting used to belong to a private museum.

qs.en: The property belonged to the family for decades.

qs.en: We belonged to the same generation and shared the same values.

qs.en: We belonged to a literary circle that met every week.

qs.en: They belonged to an ethnic minority that lived in the region.

qs.en: Tomorrow, I will officially belong to this association.

qs.en: One day, I will belong to a professional orchestra.

qs.en: After your registration, you will officially belong to the club.

qs.en: This building will belong to the city after the sale.

qs.en: The forest will henceforth belong to the state after the purchase.

qs.en: We will belong to the same professional network next year.

qs.s: Ces documents ___ aux archives nationales à partir de l'année prochaine.
qs.en: These documents will belong to the national archives starting next year.

qs.en: All the assets will belong to the children after the parents' death.

qs.s: Si j'avais plus de temps, j'___ à davantage d'associations.

qs.s: Si tu acceptais, tu ___ désormais à notre équipe.

qs.s: Dans ce cas, le terrain ___ au promoteur immobilier.

qs.s: Si nous acceptions leur offre, nous ___ à leur réseau international.

qs.s: Dans une telle situation, nous ___ à une catégorie bien différente.
qs.en: In such a situation, we would belong to a very different category.

qs.en: If you joined this organization, you would belong to an influential network.

qs.en: With this status, you would belong to the category of certified professionals.

qs.en: If the negotiations succeeded, these islands would belong to our country.

qs.en: You need to belong to a recognized group to obtain this funding.

qs.s: Je souhaite que vous ___ à notre association avant la fin du mois.
qs.en: I wish that you would belong to our association before the end of the month.

qs.s: Cette voiture ___ à mon voisin, pas à moi.
qs.en: This car belongs to my neighbor, not to me.

qs.s: Ces territoires ___ historiquement à cette nation.

qs.s: Après des années d'emprisonnement, il a enfin retrouvé la ___ .
qs.en: After years of imprisonment, he finally regained his freedom.

qs.s: L'oiseau dans sa cage rêve de ___ .
qs.en: The bird in its cage dreams of freedom.

qs.s: La ___ est un droit fondamental garanti par la Constitution.
qs.en: Liberty is a fundamental right guaranteed by the Constitution.

qs.s: Les révolutionnaires se sont battus pour la ___ du peuple.
qs.en: The revolutionaries fought for the people's liberty.

qs.s: La ___ de la presse est essentielle dans une démocratie.
qs.en: Freedom of the press is essential in a democracy.

qs.s: Chaque citoyen a le droit d'exercer sa ___ d'expression.
qs.en: Every citizen has the right to exercise their freedom of expression.

qs.s: Les philosophes des Lumières ont défendu ___ liberté individuelle.
qs.en: The Enlightenment philosophers defended individual liberty.

qs.s: C'est ___ vraie liberté que de pouvoir choisir sa propre voie.
qs.en: It is a true freedom to be able to choose one's own path.

qs.s: Tu as ___ d'argent pour acheter ce livre ?
qs.en: Do you have enough money to buy this book?

qs.s: Elle n'a pas dormi ___ cette nuit.
qs.en: She didn't sleep enough last night.

qs.s: Ce film est ___ intéressant, je le recommande.
qs.en: This film is quite interesting, I recommend it.

qs.s: Il fait ___ froid ce matin pour sortir sans manteau.
qs.en: It is rather cold this morning to go out without a coat.
